name: Erc20transfer
fix_description: Function 0x0a1b0b91 = erc20TransferFrom(address,address,address,uint256) accepts a user-supplied from address and calls transferFrom without validating msg.sender == from. Anyone can pass victim addresses to drain their approved tokens. Fix: validate from == msg.sender, or remove the from parameter.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit against an obviously unsafe external function that lets the caller trigger an arbitrary ERC20 transferFrom-like action. The PoC is extremely short, requires no DeFi knowledge, no flash loans, and almost no setup beyond forking and calling the vulnerable contract once.
